- The file change takes effect on restart. Until then, the live state depends on the runtime command I ran.
- whitelist.json is still empty. I did not restore it because I don't know its earlier contents.
- `online-mode=false` was already set before this deploy. It allows any username to connect and needs a separate review.
- Two short join-and-leave sessions (newplayer22–26) were unexplained and not investigated.

My first report submission was rejected for missing fields. The corrected one was accepted.
